title: Plant Network Incident Response
description: Plant network failures affecting food production operations
immediate_actions: Assess impact on food production operations
Notify Coastal Foods IT Operations team
Implement emergency network bypass if available
Contact plant management for production impact assessment
investigation_steps: Check network device status and logs
Verify network connectivity to plant facilities
Analyze network traffic patterns for anomalies
resolution_steps: Restart failed network devices following standard procedures
Implement redundant network paths if available
Apply network configuration fixes or rollbacks
Coordinate with local IT lead for plant systems
verification: Test network connectivity to production systems
Confirm with plant staff that network is operational
escalation_contacts: Escalation Group: Coastal Foods IT Operations
special_considerations: Plant changes require approval from the local IT lead
Plant network is critical for food production operations
Food safety regulations may apply to production processes
Maintain operational safety during network restoration
